02 The Experience

One Day in Venice

01
Panels With a Pulse
Inside the Craft
The creative team behind Spider-Man: Brand New Day broke down how they bring the film to life—from directing and cinematography to production design, editing and visual development. Featuring Destin Daniel Cretton, Brett Pawlak, Charlie Wood, Gina Sansom, Harry Yoon and Ryan Meinerding.
02
The Creator Panel
Creators, Moderated by the Director
Hosted by Naz Perez & Coy Jandreau, featuring Jen Markham, Yasin "YaseenThatGuy" Muhammad, Giovanni "EditedByGeo" Marks, and Angelo "AngelinkFilms" Barrière — with Destin Daniel Cretton himself flipping the format and moderating.
03
The Reveal
100+ Pieces of Concept Art & BTS
Suit, props, script notes, and over a hundred pieces of concept art and behind-the-scenes material — shown in the room, most of it never seen outside the production.
04
The Stunts
ACTION, UP CLOSE
The film's stunt team brought the action to Lighthouse with a live demonstration and look at the practical work and choreography behind the film.
05
The Trailer
First Look, Room Only
An exclusive, embargoed first look at the trailer — screened once, for the people in the room, before anyone else in the world.
no photography — it was embargoed. that's the point.
06
The Street
SPIDER-MAN TAKES VENICE
Movement artist "Modern Tarzan" brought Spider-Man into the streets of Venice—scaling Windward Circle and stopping passersby in their tracks.
"Truly some NY sh*t in Venice!" — Windward Circle passerby
